items.title: Nvidia’s CUDA Moat Is Shrinking: AI Got Software Running on AMD Chips “in Three Days”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAnthropic’s IPO roadshow showed that, with its Mythos model, it got running on an Advanced Micro Devices (AMD:NASDAQ) chip in three days, against the six to 12 months it typically took. That cuts at the switching costs behind Nvidia’s (NVDA:NASDAQ) 75% gross margin, and AMD and Arista Networks (ANET:NYSE) stand to gain.
